audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows disagreed with their own whys: level 1 was 'Skill' under 'your level-1 base damage and autos out-trade Wukong', levels 2-3 were 'Tryndamere' under whys calling them even, levels 4-5 were 'Skill' under a why saying they favour Wukong, and level 6 was 'Skill' under a why saying it flips to you.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Tryndamere, Skill, Skill, Wukong, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere] and every whys[] string matches it; Tryndamere wins 53.56% over 1912 games.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 realigned in both layers with ratings, and phases[3].why rewritten so the Wukong-sided stage states why he owns it.

audit.why: Spikes read correctly: Wukong at 3-5 on clone plus gap-close, Tryndamere at 6 and from his first crit item onward.

audit.whatIsWrong: Crushing Blow's auto-attack reset was absent, and both W entries ('Wait for his W decoy', 'Crit the clone') carried boilerplate descriptions that never explained what the decoy actually does.
audit.why: His combo opens with an attack wind-up rather than a visible cast, so the wind-up is the cue to step out. Warrior Trickster leaves a decoy behind and stealths the real body, which is exactly why a loaded crit spent on the cast is wasted.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[0].d around the decoy/stealth behaviour and dontsFull[1].d around the Q reset tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere for Nimbus Strike, Warrior Trickster or Cyclone.
audit.why: enemyKit is null in this brief — Wukong's kit data was not supplied, so no per-rank cooldowns could be verified. Nothing numeric was invented.
audit.corrected: Left cooldown-free; flagged for a re-run once the Wukong kit is available.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Nimbus Strike's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His clone bait and gap-close own this window — trade only around Nimbus Strike's cooldown. If behind, farm safe and hold your E.

edits.before: Build 100 fury on the wave, E-spin onto Wukong with a crit loaded, AA-W slow, and spin out before the answer.
edits.after: Warrior Trickster leaves a decoy and stealths him — wait for the stealth to end, then spend your crit on the real body.

edits.before: That is Wukong's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His W leaves a decoy and stealths the real body — hold your crit until he reappears.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crushing Blow is an auto reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.

notes: enemyKit was null in this brief, so no Wukong cooldowns could be verified and none were written — worth a re-run when the kit is present. packet suspectName 'Pop Undying Rage' in wants.you[1] is a FALSE POSITIVE (Tryndamere's real R name); left unchanged.
